ingredients.name: soft herbed cheese, 5.2 ounces, room temperature
eggs, beaten lightly to make an egg wash

steps.instruction: Mix 11 ounces of goat cheese, 1 package of herbed cheese and 4 ounces of ricotta.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a small pan over medium-low heat.
Add 1 tablespoon each of minced garlic, shallot and chives.
Add 2 teaspoons each of minced thyme, basil and tarragon.
Cook the herbs for 2 minutes, until soft and fragrant.
Fold the herbs into the cheese mixture.
Cover the bowl and chill it for at least 30 minutes, until firm.
Divide the firm cheese mixture into 8 equal portions.
Shape each portion into a cake about 3/4 inch thick.
Coat each cake in 1 cup of flour, then shake off the extra.
Dip each cake in the beaten eggs, then in 1 cup of bread crumbs on both sides.
Set the cakes on a wire rack.
Heat 4 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the cheese cakes gently and fry 1 minute on each side.
steps.spoken: Gently add the cheese cakes and fry 1 to 2 minutes on each side, until golden.

steps.instruction: Drain the cheese cakes on a wire rack.
